The closest verified wins are at the 34th Annie Awards (held February 2007 for 2006 work): Best Character Animation in a Television Production for "The Blind Bandit" (Ya Jae Myung) and Best Directing in an Animated Television Production for "The Drill" (Giancarlo Volpe). I found no award explicitly dated 2006, and the Emmy the show won was from 2007, not 2006. I also need to correct my earlier answer: the 33rd Annie top TV prize went to *Star Wars: Clone Wars II*, so the Avatar nomination I cited is unverified.

CONFIDENCE: 40
